text:
Taylor: FYI small but noisy problem after the routing TTL tweak: immediate reconnects create two brief active rows in console and sometimes two billing "charges" for the same logical session.
Ivy: saw that alert. SSE clients mostly?
Taylor: yes SSE-heavy, a few WS multiplexed. confirmed repro with local harness: soft-close -> reconnect -> new route claim occurs before old tombstone cleared. billing logs show overlapping charge-starts ~200-400ms apart.
Marcus: logs?
Taylor: ```
[proxy] 2026-04-12T01:02:11Z route-claim cid=usrA ttl=50ms shard=eu-1
[proxy] 2026-04-12T01:02:11.120 client-close cid=usrA code=1000
[client] 2026-04-12T01:02:11.180 reconnect cid=usrA new_shard=eu-2
[billing] 2026-04-12T01:02:11.200 charge-start s=usrA
[billing] 2026-04-12T01:02:11.460 charge-start s=usrA.2
```
Ivy: billing is keyed on route claim so overlap looks like two sessions. Console dedupe uses Last-Event-ID for SSE but many clients don't send it on reconnect.
Marcus: short-term: revert TTL tweak on canary and add console UI to hide/annotate overlaps <500ms. Long-term: billing idempotency window keyed by fingerprint (client-id + ip-bucket + ua) or require first-byte before charge.
Taylor: fingerprinting may have NAT false-positives. Suggested hybrid: prefer Last-Event-ID when present, else fingerprint with short window (1s).
billing-bot: noted: prototype idempotent-charge RFC recommended.
Ivy: telemetry: add metric "route_claim_overlap_ms" histogram and an alert if overlap_rate >0.25% in 5m. Also sample headers for affected reconnects.
deploy-bot: canary rollback started by Ivy at 01:15 UTC.
Marcus: I'll open INFRA tickets: revert-canary, proxy-drain-flush patch, and BILL RFC for idempotent-charging. Also add a streaming-harness test for immediate reconnects to prevent regressions.
Taylor: thanks  we'll follow up with SDK team to encourage sending Last-Event-ID on reconnects.
